title: Content Security Policy: add `img-src data:`
body:

> NTM: Mitigate [this ticket](https://portal.microsofticm.com/imp/v5/incidents/details/700243953/summary) once the PR is merged.

## Changelog Entry

<!-- Please paste your new entry from CHANGELOG.MD here. Entry is not required for work only related to development purposes. -->

### Fixed

- Fixed Content Security Policy documentation and sample in PR, by [@compulim](https://github.com/compulim) in PR [#5648](https://github.com/microsoft/BotFramework-WebChat/pull/5648)
   - Added `img-src data:`, required for icons

## Description

<!-- Please discuss the changes you have worked on. What do the changes do; why is this PR needed? -->

Our icons is now using SVG in CSS. We should suggest developers to relax `img-src data:` in their Content Security Policy.

```
:global(.webchat) .icon--dismiss {
  --webchat__component-icon--mask: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="..."/></svg>');
}
```

Also fixed our CSP samples as it was allowlisting MockBot 3 instead of MockBot 4.

## Specific Changes

<!-- Please list the changes in a concise manner. -->

- Updated `CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY.md`
   - Added `img-src data:`
- Updated sample 01/j.bundle-with-content-security-policy`
   - Added `img-src data:`
   - Updated `connect-src` to point to MockBot 4 instead of MockBot 3
- Added test to verify our baseline CSP
